n24ffd0d616.headline: Zeman, Babiš and Schillerová discussed the budget in Lány: Deficit will be higher than 116 billion
n24ffd0d616.summary: The Czech Finance Minister indicated the 2021 budget deficit will likely be higher than the initial 116 billion crowns forecast due to additional coronavirus-related measures.
n24ffd0d616.why: Budget deficits affect government borrowing, fiscal sustainability, and economic policy in the Czech Republic.
